description: Compress videos with FFmpeg for websites: videos embedded in a web page, landing page or docs site. Compares codec and CRF quality, audits embedded videos on a site, and scans and optimizes videos across a website source project. Use when the user wants a smaller video for the web or to optimize site videos. Do NOT use for videos uploaded to social media (X, YouTube, TikTok, Instagram); those platforms re-encode uploads and need their own export settings.
